sources: AAVSO International Variable Star Index (VSX), Watson et al. 2006; via VizieR B/vsx and the VSX API
notes: epoch is HJD (time of primary minimum for eclipsing systems, maximum for pulsators); dur is the eclipse duration (EA/CVE) or rise duration (RR) in percent of the period; cls: EA detached EB, EB beta Lyr, EW contact, CVE eclipsing CV, CV cataclysmic, RR RR Lyrae, DS delta Scuti/SX Phe, CEP Cepheid.
